## Introduction

This is a parameterised report focusing on monitoring weekly progress for different teams especially those that submit data through Kobotoolbox.

```{r}
library(tidyverse, warn.conflicts = FALSE)
#install.packages("KoboconnectR")
library(KoboconnectR)
library(janitor)
library(gt)
library(httr)
library(readxl)
library(here)
library(lubridate)
```

so far the following projects are being implemented

-   Nzatonse V

-   Harm Mitigation

## Nzatonse V

```{r}
file_1<-here("nzatonse_v.csv")
nzatonse_v<- read.csv(file_1, sep = ";")
```

```{r}
nzatonse_clean<-nzatonse_v |> 
  clean_names()

nzatonse_cleaner<-nzatonse_clean |>
  select(district:name_of_service_provider_1,method_if_other,x_id)
```

```{r}
nzatonse_cleaner<-nzatonse_cleaner|> 
  mutate(date = ymd(date),
         week_of_the_month = factor(week_of_the_month),
         facility_name_neno = factor(facility_name_neno),
         facility_name_ntcheu = factor(facility_name_ntcheu),
         on_art = factor(on_art, levels = c("Yes","No")),
         service_delivery_point = factor(service_delivery_point),
         team = factor(team),
         client_consent = factor(client_consent),
         sex = factor(sex),
         marital_status = factor(marital_status),
         education_level = factor(education_level),
         age_category = factor(age_category),
         method = factor(method),
         parity = factor(parity,levels = c("Zero","One","Two","Three","Four above")),
         hiv_status = factor(hiv_status),
         age = as.integer(age),
         number_of_doses = as.integer(number_of_doses),
         number_of_cycles = as.integer(number_of_cycles),
         number_of_condoms = as.integer(number_of_condoms),
         number_of_ec_ps = as.integer(number_of_ec_ps),
         number_of_condoms_back_up = as.integer(number_of_condoms_back_up),
         client_category = factor(client_category)) |> 
  as_tibble()
```

```{r}
methods<-c("DMPA (IM)","DMPA-SC (SI)","Implant Insertion (3 years)","Implant Insertion (5 years)", "DMPA-SC (PI)","Condoms","COC", "IUD-Copper T","Emergency Contraceptive Pills","Implant Insertion (4 Years)")

)

cols<-c("other_services_counselled_without_a_method","other_services_cervical_cancer_screening","other_services_cryo_therapy","other_services_hts","other_services_sti_service",            "other_services_art_therapy","other_services_pregnancy_test",         "other_services_post_abortion_care","other_services_gbv_service", "team","district")
```

```{r}
other_services<-nzatonse_cleaner |>
  filter(between(date, as.Date("2026-02-09"), as.Date("2026-02-13"))) |> 
  select(district, team, starts_with("other_services")) |> 
  select(-c(other_services,other_services_2)) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = other_services_counselled_without_a_method:other_services_gbv_service,
               names_to = "service_type", 
               values_to = "value") |>
  filter(value == 1) |> 
  mutate(service_col = case_when(service_type = str_detect(service_type,"gbv") ~ "GBV only",
                               service_type = str_detect(service_type, "sti") ~ "STI Only",
                               service_type = str_detect(service_type, "cervical") ~ "CC Screening",
                               service_type = str_detect(service_type, "therapy") ~ "CC Screening",
                               service_type = str_detect(service_type, "art") ~ "HIV Only",
                               service_type = str_detect(service_type, "pregnancy") ~ "Pregnancy Testing",
                               service_type = str_detect(service_type, "abortion") ~ "PAC",
                               service_type = str_detect(service_type, "hts") ~ "HIV Only",
                               service_type = str_detect(service_type, "hts") ~ "HIV Only")) |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  mutate(district = factor(district),
         indicator = factor(service_col, levels = c("HIV Only","STI Only", "GBV only","Pregnancy Testing")))


performance_serv<-other_services |> 
  group_by(team, service_col) %>%
  summarise(
    total_clients = n(),
    .groups = "drop")
```

```{r weekly update}
client_visits<-nzatonse_cleaner |> 
  filter(between(date,as.Date("2026-02-09"), as.Date("2026-12-12"))) |> 
  select(method, district, client_category, team, date,week_of_the_month,other_services_counselled_without_a_method, other_services_gbv_service,other_services_pregnancy_test, other_services_art_therapy, other_services_sti_service,other_services_hts,other_services_cervical_cancer_screening)

aggregate_visits<-client_visits |> 
  group_by(client_category, team, date) |> 
  summarise(n = n()) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(percentage = round(n/sum(n)*100,2))
  

          
  
aggregate_visits |> 
  group_by(team,n) |> 
  gt()
```

## Total SRH

```{r Total SRH performance}

# Set weekly target per team
weekly_target <- 500

# Aggregate data by week and team
weekly_performance <- aggregate_visits %>%
  # Ensure date is in Date format
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  # Create week variable (adjust based on your week definition)
  mutate(
    week = floor_date(date, unit = "week", week_start = 1),  # Starts on Sunday
    # Alternative: week = floor_date(date, unit = "week", week_start = 1) # Starts on Monday
    week_label = format(week, "%b %d, %Y")) %>%
  # Group by team and week
  group_by(team, week) %>%
  summarise(achieved = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  # Add target and calculate variance
  mutate(target = weekly_target,
    variance = achieved - target,
    achievement_pct = round((achieved / target) * 100, 1),
    status = case_when(
      achievement_pct >= 100 ~ "✅ Met/Exceeded",
      achievement_pct >= 80 ~ "⚠️ Near Target",
      TRUE ~ "❌ Below Target" )) %>%
  # Sort by team and week
  arrange(team, week)

weekly_performance |> 
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Team-Specific Service Target Achievement - Total SRH**"),
    subtitle = md("Based on data from **Feb 09-13, 2026** | Targets vary by team and service"))%>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  ) %>%
  # Make team names (row groups) bold
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold", size = "large"),
    locations = cells_row_groups(groups = everything())
  ) %>%
  data_color(
    columns = achievement_pct,
    colors = scales::col_numeric(
      palette = c("#FF6B6B", "#FFE66D", "#4ECDC4"),
      domain = c(0, 100, 200)
    ))
```

```{r}
# Define service columns
other_services_cols <- c(
 "CC Screening",
  "HIV Only",
  "STI Only",
  "Pregnancy Testing",
  "GBV only",
  "PAC")

# Create a comprehensive targets dataframe with team AND service specific targets
nzatonse_team_service_targets <- expand.grid(
  team = c("Team A", "Team B", "Team C (Neno)"),  # Add all your teams
  service_col = other_services_cols,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
      weekly_target = case_when(
      # HTS targets vary by team
      service_col == "HIV Only" & team == "Team A" ~ 112.5
,
      service_col == "HIV Only" & team == "Team B" ~ 112.5,
      service_col == "HIV Only" & team == "Team C (Neno)" ~ 17,
      
      # STI service targets
      service_col == "STI Only" & team == "Team A" ~ 62.5
,
      service_col == "STI Only" & team == "Team B" ~ 62.5
,
      service_col == "STI Only" & team == "Team C (Neno)" ~ 17,
      
      # Cervical cancer screening
      service_col == "CC Screening" & team == "Team A" ~ 8,
      service_col == "CC Screening" & team == "Team B" ~ 8,
      service_col == "CC Screening" & team == "Team C (Neno)" ~3,
      
      # Pregnancy test
      service_col == "Pregnancy Testing" & team == "Team A" ~ 38,
      service_col == "Pregnancy Testing" & team == "Team B" ~ 38,
      service_col == "Pregnancy Testing" & team == "Team C (Neno)" ~ 7,
      
      # GBV service
      service_col == "GBV only" & team == "Team A" ~ 13,
      service_col == "GBV only" & team == "Team B" ~ 13,
      service_col == "GBV only" & team == "Team C (Neno)" ~ 3,
      
      # Default fallback
      TRUE ~ 50
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# First, create the team_service_performance dataframe
team_service_performance <- performance_serv %>%
  # Rename to match target dataset
  rename(service_name = service_col) %>%
  
  # Join with targets
  left_join(
    nzatonse_team_service_targets,
    by = c("team" = "team", "service_name" = "service_col")
  ) %>%
  
  # Calculate metrics
  mutate(
    # For a single week (Feb 09-13, 2026), weekly_target is the target
    weekly_target = weekly_target,
    expected_total = weekly_target,  # Since it's just one week
    achievement_pct = (total_clients / weekly_target) * 100,
    
    # Create status based on achievement percentage
    status = case_when(
      achievement_pct >= 100 ~ "✅ Met/Exceeded",
      achievement_pct >= 80 ~ "⚠️ Near Target",
      TRUE ~ "❌ Below Target"
    ),
    
    gap_to_target = total_clients - weekly_target,
    
    # Weekly average is just total_clients since it's one week
    weekly_average = total_clients
  ) %>%
  
  # Select and arrange columns
  select(team, service_name, achieved = total_clients, weekly_average, 
         weekly_target, expected_total, achievement_pct, status, gap_to_target) %>%
  arrange(team, desc(achievement_pct))

# Now create the GT table
team_service_performance %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "team") %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Team-Specific Service Target Achievement**"),
    subtitle = md("Based on data from **Feb 09-13, 2026** | Targets vary by team and service")
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    service_name = "Service",
    achieved = "Total Achieved",
    weekly_average = "Weekly Avg",
    weekly_target = "Weekly Target",
    expected_total = "Expected Total",
    achievement_pct = "Achievement %",
    status = "Status",
    gap_to_target = "Gap"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(achieved, expected_total, weekly_average, gap_to_target), 
             decimals = 0) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = achievement_pct, decimals = 1, suffix = "%") %>%
  data_color(
    columns = achievement_pct,
    colors = scales::col_numeric(
      palette = c("#FF6B6B", "#FFE66D", "#4ECDC4"),
      domain = c(0, 100, 200)
    )
  ) %>%
  data_color(
    columns = gap_to_target,
    colors = scales::col_numeric(
      palette = c("#FF6B6B", "white", "#4ECDC4"),
      domain = c(-100, 0, 100)
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#DFF0D8"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = status,
      rows = status == "✅ Met/Exceeded"
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#FCF8E3"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = status,
      rows = status == "⚠️ Near Target"
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#F2DEDE"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = status,
      rows = status == "❌ Below Target"
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Gap = Actual - Expected | Red = Below target, Green = Above target",
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = gap_to_target)
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  ) %>%
  # Make team names (row groups) bold
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold", size = "large"),
    locations = cells_row_groups(groups = everything())
  )
```
